text:
maria: Quick check — onboarding for mosaic-3b-mini is hitting the config lint in CI. Error says missing `tokenizer.pad_token` and the weights path points at the staging bucket.
jon: link to the PR? i can take a look when i have a minute.
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4321 — i pushed a draft with the model bundle. CI output excerpt:
```text
ValidationError: config.json: missing required field `tokenizer.pad_token`
ValidationError: weights.s3_path: must be in `s3://redwood-weights/` (found s3://redwood-staging/mosaic-3b-mini/)
``` 
tara: ugh, staging path slip again. did the onboarding script not replace env var?
kevin: i ran the lint locally — the schema change from last month tightened the `tokenizer` block (now requires `pad_token` and `eos_token`). older checkpoints omit pad in a lot of our third-party bundles.
maria: yeah, this model vendor didn't include `pad_token`. i tried adding a fallback in the config but CI still fails because gatekeeper enforces `required: true`.
jon: two ways: (1) update the model bundle to include explicit `pad_token` (preferred), or (2) make the validator accept a default for legacy bundles and emit a warning. which do we want for onboarding speed?
kevin: for PL we should allow a default for now to unblock onboarding, then follow up to ask vendors to include explicit fields. i'll open a tiny PR to change the schema to `required: false` + default injected by the lint helper.
config-bot: [config-lint v2.4] running on maria/mosaic-3b-mini/config.json
ci-bot: build #9812 failed — lint step
tara: if we allow default, can we log a telemetry event so we know how many bundles rely on the fallback?
kevin: yes, i'll add a small metric `config.fallback.pad_token` when the linter injects the default.
maria: sounds good. for the weights path i'll update the bundle to `s3://redwood-weights/mosaic-3b-mini/v1/weights.tgz` in the PR.
jon: ping me on the PR once kevin's schema change is up — i'll review the validator change.
kevin: will do. plan: (a) update schema validator PR (make pad_token optional + default injection + telemetry), (b) maria updates weights path in model bundle, (c) run CI, (d) gatekeeper follow-up to require explicit pad_token for new vendor submissions by next month.
maria: timeline: i can update bundle today, run local lint, push. kevin, do you want me to wait for your PR or push and we re-run CI after schema merge?
kevin: push your bundle change now — i'll make the validator change a hotfix branch and we can re-run CI after.
tara: 
- maria: update bundle path
- kevin: validator change + metric
- jon: review
- tara: coordinate vendor follow-up
maria: thanks all — i'll push in ~30m and add notes in the PR. :thumbsup:
jon: thanks — :shipit:
